title: Welcome to UniQCAI: one console that collects every quick-commerce report for your brands.
s1: An admin signs in with their work email and password.
s2: All your client brands sit in one list. Let's open Del Monte.
s3: Each brand shows its platform connections, split into Ads and Sales, with a live health status for every login.
s4: Here is an important safety check. One portal login can hold several businesses. If the portal shows a different business than expected, UniQCAI stops, rather than downloading the wrong company's data.
s5: Access controls who can see this brand. Each brand team sees only its own brand, and its own reports.
s6: Platform accounts lists every portal login. One login can serve several brands. Passwords are stored encrypted, and are never shown again.
s7: Connecting a new platform is a guided set-up. Choose the platform, add the login, choose where the verification code arrives, and pick the reports.
s8: Verification codes arrive in these mailboxes, and UniQCAI reads them automatically. Nobody has to forward an O.T.P.
s9: To download on demand, choose the brand, tick the reports you need, pick a date range, and start the run with a single click.
s10: Coming next: run history with live progress, daily schedules, and the report library, where every downloaded file is ready for your team.
end: Set it up once, and your reports are collected every day.
